findings.passage: I think that, broadly speaking, our election system is fair. I would support same-day voter registration, early voting, automatic voter registration, pre-canvassing of mail ballots (a reform supported and requested by all our counties), stronger limits on contributions to political candidates, and stronger requirements around full disclosure of all spending meant to influence the outcome of elections.
findings.note: Her answer in the WESA voter guide to a question about mail ballots, drop boxes and voter verification requirements. She lists the changes she would support and does not mention ID requirements. Date is the guide's first-published date.
